criteria: Apply the ticket and PR limits to the named agent or repo, not a different scope.
Recover or park owned workerless PRs before new work, within one hour, even when red.
Require a verifier PASS on the current head before merge; missing proof cannot count as Done.
Keep the same PR owner responsible through merge.
Give the required next action without contradicting it elsewhere in the answer.

expected.1: No. Five tickets in flight per agent label is the limit. Ship one before starting a Todo ticket.
expected.2: Give the existing PR a fresh worker within the hour to fix it, or park the PR and return its card to Todo. Do not wait a day, ignore it because it is red, or open a replacement PR.
expected.3: This merge broke the proof-before-merge rule. Return the card to Todo for verification, not Done. Obtain the missing proof; the merge alone is not success.
expected.4: First restore a live worker to the owned orphan PR, or park it and return its card to Todo. Do not start the new Todo ticket first.
expected.5: No. The repo-wide cap is 10 open PRs. Finish existing PRs before opening another.
expected.6: Keep at most 5 open PRs for the agent. Park at least the 2 extras and return their cards to Todo.
expected.7: The same owner who built and opened the PR carries it through merge, following pstack autopilot-full. Passing verification does not hand ownership to someone else.
